5ce596ed-3d5b-41dc-aa5a-bb18605ff703.suggestedTitle: Remove alerts, events, and other attachments from a case in the Attachments tab
5ce596ed-3d5b-41dc-aa5a-bb18605ff703.summary: Users can now remove attachments from a case directly in the case Attachments tab. Each alerts table (Security, Observability, and stack alerts) gets a **Remove from case** bulk action and a per-row **Remove from case** action, and the related PRs add the same removal for events and saved-object attachments. The controls show only to users who can delete attachments, the confirmation and activity-log entry count the items removed (for example, "Remove 3 alerts"), and bulk removal is disabled when "select all" is used because that also matches alerts hidden by the table's time range. The EASE alerts table does not get removal.
5ce596ed-3d5b-41dc-aa5a-bb18605ff703.reasoning: New UI actions in the Attachments tab that change the documented case workflow, and the published Attach objects to cases page describes adding alerts but not removing them (already tracked in docs-content #9038).

a0006e52-c00e-4618-ad75-26272d79dd93.suggestedTitle: Cases attachments API is now public (technical preview)
a0006e52-c00e-4618-ad75-26272d79dd93.summary: The Cases attachments API moves from internal to public as a technical preview in 9.6. Six new routes under `/api/cases/{caseId}/attachments` (create, replace, find, get, delete one, delete all) return the unified attachment shape (for example `type: comment` with `data.content`) and cover the legacy `/comments` routes; `GET /alerts` and `POST /files` stay on the legacy routes, and file uploads through attachments create are blocked in favor of the files API. The PR regenerates `oas_docs/output/kibana.yaml` and `kibana.serverless.yaml` with the six new operations, each tagged `x-state: Technical preview; added in 9.6.0`.
a0006e52-c00e-4618-ad75-26272d79dd93.reasoning: API reference only — the published reference and CLI pages are generated from the OpenAPI output this PR regenerates (six operations with x-state technical preview), no hand-written narrative page is affected, and the legacy comment operations are unchanged.

2d73d621-7b48-4d33-bfbe-2452ba44fd79.suggestedTitle: Anonymization page now appears in navigation and replaces the Advanced Settings entry
2d73d621-7b48-4d33-bfbe-2452ba44fd79.summary: Switches users over to the new **Anonymization** page: it is linked under **AI** in the navigation of every solution (classic and serverless), and the raw `ai:anonymizationSettings` JSON entry is no longer listed in Advanced Settings. The setting is registered read-only in the UI but still writable through the settings API and `uiSettings.overrides` in `kibana.yml`; NER rules have no UI on the new page, so those are the only ways to edit them. The inference plugin also tells the page's pattern tester whether anonymization runs on worker threads (`xpack.inference.workers.anonymization.enabled`).
2d73d621-7b48-4d33-bfbe-2452ba44fd79.reasoning: The Advanced Settings reference was already updated in the stacked page PR (#295895) and now points users to the Anonymization page, but its note says to configure anonymization there without covering NER rules, which still can't be edited in the UI; the new page itself is covered by the sibling item, so this should be folded into the same docs issue.

03ed3a50-8f2b-4252-9b64-9c8019d32cca.suggestedTitle: Choose which sensitive values are masked in AI requests on the new Anonymization page
03ed3a50-8f2b-4252-9b64-9c8019d32cca.summary: Adds an **Anonymization** page under Stack Management → AI (a sibling of GenAI Settings) for choosing which sensitive values are masked before AI requests are sent to a model. It has built-in patterns (toggle, entity type, regex, live example; not editable), custom patterns (add or edit flyout with inline regex validation), a pattern tester that runs enabled rules against sample JSON or text and shows the masked output with a breakdown, and settings for the master "Mask PII in AI requests" switch and `onFailure` behavior. Masking covers AI features that use Kibana's shared AI integration with any connector; features that call a connector directly are not masked. The page and pattern tester require an Enterprise license, plus Advanced Settings save access and the Connectors capability.
03ed3a50-8f2b-4252-9b64-9c8019d32cca.reasoning: A whole new management page with license, privilege, and scope caveats has no narrative documentation; the same PR's docs change only refreshes the Advanced Settings entry, so it doesn't cover the page.

6d77a913-4fc6-4acd-9b99-8e03a79e177d.suggestedTitle: ai:anonymizationSettings was widened to all solutions, then moved to the Anonymization page
6d77a913-4fc6-4acd-9b99-8e03a79e177d.summary: Moves the `ai:anonymizationSettings` uiSetting from the Observability category to General so every solution view lists it, adds the Security and Workplace AI serverless allowlists, and removes the Observability AI Assistant shortcut. It also fixes streaming de-anonymization so responses containing masked PII render incrementally instead of arriving as one chunk, and injects anonymization instructions when a request has no system prompt but masked content. The Advanced Settings listing was superseded before 9.6 by the Anonymization page work (#295895, #297148), which hides the raw entry.
6d77a913-4fc6-4acd-9b99-8e03a79e177d.reasoning: PR claims the setting is available in Advanced Settings for every solution, but follow-up PRs hide it in 9.6, so the user-visible docs for this PR are limited to the entry change it already made in the same PR; the streaming and instruction fixes are internal behavior fixes.

35e5171a-4fb8-4d55-a639-dbe883d599ba.suggestedTitle: Customize the columns in the Similar cases tab
35e5171a-4fb8-4d55-a639-dbe883d599ba.summary: The Similar cases tab table now has a **Columns** button, matching the main Cases list. Users can show or hide columns such as created on, assignees (with avatars), comment count, status, severity, custom fields, and, with templates v2, global fields (a user-picker field shows avatars). The **Created on** column is shown by default, the **Name** column is always visible and first and doesn't appear in the picker, and the selection is saved in the browser's local storage separately from the main Cases list preference. Sorting is a follow-up PR and is out of scope here.
35e5171a-4fb8-4d55-a639-dbe883d599ba.reasoning: New UI control in the Similar cases tab, which the published docs only mention in passing ("check the Similar cases tab"); writer work is already tracked in docs-content #9327 and #9326, so this is mostly a duplicate to link or skip as already tracked.
